 SOAH Docket 473-26-16349
PUC Docket 59475
May 19, 2026

Good Cause for Failing to Comply:

To Whom it May Concern,

I want to start by stating I am not a lawyer and do not have the means to hire a lawyer. In order
to defend my homestead, I should not need a lawyer to participate in this process. However,
here I am and I missed a critical deadline.

I received 2 packets from PUC of Texas on March 31, 2026 concerning the Bell County East
Switch to Big Hill Substation 765kV transmission line project with confusing and overwhelming
information. I immediately started calling the contact numbers provided as well as Rep
Schwertner's office and Wilson's office for any help they could give me and my neighbors.

With the help of all the resources at my disposal, I managed to get my "Request to Intervene"
filed by the deadline of April 27,2026. I was told by numerous people helping more information
would be needed but I was not given the resources to know when the deadlines were that I
needed to meet.

While my boyfriend was driving to a job in Burnet on May 14th, he passed a sign that read
Stopthisline.com and immediately told me about the website. I was out of town Friday May
15-17th judging an AKC event in Canton, TX. Once I had time to investigate this website I was
given a timeline that showed I missed a critical date of May 13, 2026. A timeline that was
created by a filing April 20,2026 - prior to and while I was talking to Texas Representative's for
help. At no time, after several calls to different offices, did anyone ever offer a timeline or
mention the May 13th deadline which was established on April 20,2026 while I was calling my
representatives for help, as well as PUC.


I accept responsibility for missing the timeline and and asking that you please accept my
testimony. The F8 link is running within 500 feet of my home and directly through my pasture.

Thank you for your consideration,
